author: Matt Palermo
releaseNotes:
1.3.1: dailyUsage is the average daily drop over the last 14 days, skipping fill days; a fill no longer resets it.

After Install
---------------------------
- open MyFuelPortal Manager from Integrations
- enter your provider's subdomain from the myfuelportal.com url you use
- enter your portal email and password
- click Done
- dailyUsage and daysUntilEmpty appear in the tank's device after 7 days of readings
